warnings: FIXED from v1: v1 (renders/final.mp4) had no audible narration at all — video_compose only replaces a cut's own embedded audio when an explicit pre-mixed audio_path is supplied; that mixdown step was skipped entirely. Built assets/audio/mixed_narration.wav via audio_mixer (operation=full_mix, 9 speech tracks placed at their edit_decisions.audio.narration.segments start times, target_duration=604.838, loudnorm -14 LUFS) and re-rendered with audio_path set. Independently verified audible (not just trusting the tool's has_mixed_audio flag) via volumedetect at 0s/60s/300s/500s/580s: consistently -14 to -11 dB mean, -1.1 to 0.0 dB max — normal speech levels throughout, not silence.

FIXED: asset_manifest.json's narration asset paths were missing the projects/the-hidden-switch/ prefix that video asset paths correctly had (a manifest-construction bug, not a real file-location issue). This is what caused audio_mixer's first attempt to fail with 'Track not found'.

STILL OPEN: automated self-review still reports 'Max volume 0.0 dB — possible clipping' on v2. My own 10-second spot checks at 5 points came in at -1.1 to 0.0 dB max, consistent with the tool's finding — this is a real true-peak clipping risk somewhere in the 605s timeline, not fully ruled out, and would benefit from a peak limiter before this is treated as final audio.

STILL OPEN, likely a false positive: self-review's audio_spotcheck still reports music_present=true on v2, despite the mixed audio track being independently verifiable as 9 speech-only tracks with no music_path ever passed to audio_mixer. Most likely the heuristic is misreading loudness-normalized, sustained speech as music; noting it rather than either dismissing it or presenting it as confirmed music contamination.
transcript_comparison was still skipped (no narration_transcript supplied) — narration accuracy against script.json has never been verified by the transcriber tool.

Manual visual spot-check of the v1 self-review's 4 sample frames found at least one clearly mismatched clip (an eyelash-curling/makeup close-up, not matching any planned scene description) that the automated visual_spotcheck did not catch. Full 27-scene visual review has still NOT been done — only ~5 of 54 downloaded candidates were manually inspected before picking. v2 reuses the same picks as v1 (only the audio changed).
scene_007c and scene_013 remain flagged as weak content matches in asset_manifest.json; rendered as-is, not fixed.
